Hello Tharushi,

Thank you for your response.

This is from WaysLuxe Real Estate. We would like to register our company as a new partner with fäm Living. At this stage, we are not looking to list a specific apartment as a holiday home, but rather to initiate a partnership for property sales and potential collaboration.

Kindly let us know the registration process, requirements, and the appropriate point of contact to proceed further.

You may also share the details at info@waysluxe.com.

Looking forward to your response.
